test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Taking the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows from the statements.

options.text: Conclusions I and II both follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
**Given:**

Statement:

All cycles are buses.

Some buses are trains.

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1b2affe39d7cf35216c49b5e09a5be4413c67876c363b6d94bee0ba10af8ba8.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No cycle is train → **False** (There is no direct or indirect relation given in the statements that confirms that no cycle is a train. Some buses that are trains could also be cycles.)

II. All cycles are trains → **False** (The statements do not provide any basis to conclude that all cycles are trains. Only some buses are trains, and since cycles are a subset of buses, it does not lead to all cycles being trains.)

Hence, **none of the conclusions follow.**
